messages.subject: 1st level results in multiple path model
parts:
Dear experts,

I'm running a 2-level path model and having some issue interpreting the 1st level results.

By default, is the 1st level results in a 2-level model centered with respect to the cluster mean or the grand mean?

Thanks,
HY

messages.author: 3fe90052fbf2f899
messages.subject: Re: 1st level results in multiple path model
parts: is the 1st level results in a 2-level model centered with respect to the cluster mean or the grand mean?

Within-cluster variability (Level 1) is variance around the cluster mean.  Between-cluster variability (Level 2) is variance of cluster means around the grand mean.
